saturnus 0.10.1 makes the desktop app easier to get: every release now has
fixed download links for the Mac and Windows installers, and the landing
page puts them next to "Open saturnus".

## Get it

- **On the web**, nothing to install: <https://ractive.ch/saturnus/app/>
  (Chrome or Edge for a serial cable; every browser for the emulated
  calculator).
- **The desktop app** `saturnus_0.10.1_…` (on Linux `saturnus-app`), with
  a `-SHA256SUMS` file beside them:
  - macOS, Apple silicon: `.dmg`, signed and notarised, or `brew trust
    --cask ractive/tap/saturnus-app` once, then `brew install --cask
    ractive/tap/saturnus-app`;
  - Windows: `.msi` or `-setup.exe` for x86_64 (`x64`) and ARM (`arm64`);
  - Linux: `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.AppImage` for x86_64 (`amd64`, `x86_64`)
    and ARM (`arm64`, `aarch64`). Add yourself to the `dialout` group to
    use a serial port.
- **The command-line tools** `saturnus` and `satx`: `cargo install`,
  Homebrew `ractive/tap`, Scoop `ractive`, or the archives and Linux
  packages below.
- **Libraries** on crates.io, all at 0.10.1.

## Downloads

- **"Download for Mac" and "Download for Windows".** The README and the
  landing page link the newest desktop app directly. Each release now
  also has `saturnus-mac.dmg`, `saturnus-windows-x64-setup.exe` and
  `saturnus-windows-arm64-setup.exe`, copies without the version, so
  `https://github.com/ractive/saturnus/releases/latest/download/saturnus-mac.dmg`
  always gets the newest one.
- **The landing page says "in your browser or as an app".** Open
  saturnus, Download for Mac and Download for Windows sit side by side at
  the top.

## Also

- **AI apps see saturnus's icon** in their list of connectors (tab-mcp
  client 0.9.0 and 0.9.1).
- **The docs link what they name**: products, models, standards, people
  and the sources of attributed claims.
- **The old addresses are gone.** `/saturnus/sw.js`, `emulator/` and
  `transfer/` no longer serve the service-worker kill switch that cleared
  out the old installed pages.
